name: Pursuit
summary: Pursuit researches business and sector changes, connects published evidence and prepares a proposal for review.
plainEnglish: Assembl connects public APIs, official records and company news.
The page shows Parliament, NZBN, legislation, Beehive, transport and GeoNet as source connections. Some connections require configured access.
The public trial searches the web for a company, sector or seller website and returns research for review, subject to availability and daily limits.
Existing private client work continues in the separately authenticated Pursuit hubs.
publicSees: Official source links and an illustrative research path
Source-linked draft proposals and reviewed exports
Links to DO, Studio and private client hubs
